title: Set 210

sentences.ko: 아, 병원? 괜찮았어. 아마 그냥 축농증일 거라고 해서 항생제를 좀 받아 왔고, 금요일까지 안 나으면 다시 가 봐야 돼.
sentences.text: Oh, the doctor? It was fine. She said it's probably just a sinus infection, so she gave me some antibiotics, and if it's not better by Friday, I have to go back in.

alts.text: Doctor was fine. She thinks it's just a sinus thing, so I got antibiotics, and if it's not better by Friday I gotta go back in.
As for my appointment with the doctor, it went fine. She said it is most likely just a sinus infection, so she prescribed antibiotics, and if it has not improved by Friday, I will need to return.

sentences.note: **sinus infection** 은 축농증(부비동염)이에요. **go back in** 은 병원에 다시 가서 진료를 받는다는 말이에요.
sentences.situation: 병원 갔다 온 얘기 가볍게 하기

sentences.ko: 그래서 다이어트는 한 4일 갔어. 동생 생일 전까지는 진짜 잘하고 있었는데, 케이크 한 조각쯤은 괜찮겠지 했거든. 근데 다음 날 남은 피자가 또 있는 거야. 그래서 월요일부터 다시 시작해야 할 것 같아.
sentences.text: So the diet lasted about four days. I was doing really well until my sister's birthday, and I figured one piece of cake wouldn't hurt, but then there was leftover pizza the next day, so I guess I'm starting over again on Monday.

alts.text: Yeah, the diet made it like four days. I was doing great till my sister's birthday, figured one slice of cake wouldn't hurt, then there was leftover pizza the next day, so I guess I'm starting over Monday.

The diet lasted approximately four days. I was doing very well until my sister's birthday, and I thought one piece of cake would do no harm, but then there was leftover pizza the following day, so I suppose I will be starting again on Monday.

sentences.note: **wouldn't hurt** 는 해가 될 건 없겠지, 괜찮겠지라는 뜻이에요. **starting over** 는 처음부터 다시 시작한다는 말이에요.

sentences.ko: 그 드라마 진짜 좋아했었는데, 시즌 2 끝나고 작가들을 다 바꿔 버려서 이제는 매 회가 다 똑같은 느낌이야. 아니 뭐, 아직 보고는 있는데, 그냥 지금까지 들인 시간이 아까워서 보는 거야.
sentences.text: I used to love that show, but they changed all the writers after the second season, and now every episode feels the same. I mean, I'm still watching it, but only because I've already put so much time into it.

alts.text: I was totally into that show, but they swapped out all the writers after season two, and now every episode's the same. I mean, I'm still watching, but just because I've already sunk so much time into it.

I used to enjoy that program very much, but they replaced the entire writing staff after the second season, and now every episode feels the same. I am still watching it, admittedly, but only because I have already invested so much time in it.

sentences.note: **used to** 는 예전에는 그랬지만 지금은 아니라는 뜻이에요. **put so much time into** 는 어떤 일에 시간을 많이 들였다는 말이에요.

sentences.ko: 오늘 밤에 애 재우는 데 한 시간 반은 걸렸어. 잠들었구나 싶어서 방에서 살금살금 나가려고 하면 눈을 뜨고 울기 시작하는 거야. 그래서 결국 아기 침대 옆 바닥에 누워 있었는데, 아마 애보다 내가 먼저 잠든 것 같아.
sentences.text: It took me like an hour and a half to get her down tonight. Every time I thought she was out and tried to sneak out of the room, she'd open her eyes and start crying, so I ended up lying on the floor next to her crib, and I'm pretty sure I fell asleep before she did.

alts.text: An hour and a half to get her down tonight. Every time I tried to sneak out, she'd wake up crying, so I ended up on the floor by her crib, and pretty sure I conked out first.

It took me approximately an hour and a half to put her to sleep this evening. Each time I believed she was asleep and tried to leave the room quietly, she would open her eyes and begin crying, so I eventually lay down on the floor beside her crib, and I believe I fell asleep before she did.

sentences.note: **get her down** 은 아이를 재운다는 말이고, **she was out** 은 완전히 잠들었다는 뜻이에요. **ended up** 은 결국 그렇게 됐다는 말이에요.

sentences.ko: 솔직히 이번 주말에 제일 좋았던 건 아무 계획이 없었다는 거야. 늦잠 자고, 팬케이크 만들어 먹고, 오후 내내 소파에서 그냥 영화 봤어. 한 달 만에 처음으로 이렇게 푹 쉰 느낌이야.
sentences.text: Honestly, the best part of my weekend was that we didn't have any plans. I slept in, I made pancakes, and we just watched movies on the couch all afternoon, and I feel more rested than I have in like a month.

alts.text: Best part of my weekend? Zero plans. Slept in, made pancakes, movies on the couch all afternoon. Haven't felt this rested in like a month.
To be honest, the best part of my weekend was that we had no plans. I slept late, I made pancakes, and we watched films on the sofa all afternoon, and I feel more rested than I have in about a month.

sentences.note: **slept in** 은 늦게까지 푹 잤다는 말이에요. **more rested than I have in** 은 ~만에 이렇게 푹 쉰 건 처음이라는 뜻이에요.
sentences.situation: 주말에 아무것도 안 하고 쉰 게 좋았다고 말하기

reviewed: 1번 casual 의 prob 은 문자에서 쓰는 줄임말이라 말로는 어색해서 고치고, 본문과 덜 겹치게 더 짧은 구어로 바꿨습니다.
2번 한국어 '남은 피자가 있었고, 그래서' 가 번역투라 친구에게 하는 말투로 고쳤습니다.
4번 casual 이 본문 첫 문장과 거의 같아서, 더 짧고 줄여 말하는 구어로 새로 썼습니다.
5번 casual 의 뒷부분이 본문과 글자 그대로 같아서 줄여 말하는 구어로 바꿨습니다.
5번 note 의 slept in 을 '일부러 늦잠' 이라고 했는데, 일부러라는 뜻은 없고 늦게까지 푹 잤다는 말이라 고쳤습니다.
